description: This file is a source HTML document for a web-based database visualizer interface. It includes HTML structure, embedded CSS styles, and JavaScript code to fetch and display database, table, and data information dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database entries in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates the HTML for and displays the data table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates the HTML for a single cell in the data table, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content if truncated.
